events.title: Baby Sign and Stay and Play

cases.refreshed: Calling all non-walking babies ages 0-12 months for a special storytime featuring American Sign Language along with songs and stories and fun! Please bring a blanket for your baby. After storytime please stay or join us to play with age-appropriate toys! Enjoy this socialization for babies and their grownups. 10:30-11:00 AM: Storytime; 11:00-12:00 PM: Stay & Play. Thank you to the Los Altos Friends of the Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

events.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer / Apoyo para jóvenes escritores

cases.refreshed: A free workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District. Help your child gain confidence as a writer. Learn how to help your child improve sentences and how to expand their idea development when writing. No registration needed. For parents and caregivers with children in third grade and above. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org. Un taller gratuito para padres presentado por la Oficina de Educación del Condado de Santa Clara y el Programa de Lectura del Distrito Bibliotecario del Condado de Santa Clara. Ayuda a tu hijo a ganar confianza como escritor. Aprende cómo ayudarlo a mejorar sus oraciones y cómo animarlo a desarrollar sus ideas a través de la escritura. No es necesario registrarse. Dirigido a padres y cuidadores con niños de tercer grado en adelante. Para adaptaciones de accesibilidad (ej. ASL), por favor complete el formulario en línea en sccld.org/accessibility 7+ días antes del evento. Si necesita ayuda con el formulario, hable con un miembro del personal de su biblioteca local, llame al (408) 540-3945 o envíenos un correo electrónico a ask@lib.sccgov.org.

events.title: STEM Wednesdays: Build a Popsicle Stick Catapult

cases.refreshed: Join us to build a catapult out of popsicle sticks, rubber bands, and a plastic spoon. After building the catapult, participants will be given pom-poms to launch. As an added challenge, participants can try to launch the pom-poms into a container. Free. Registration not required. Supplies are limited. For youth ages 5 to 10. Parents and caregivers can join their child during the activity.

cases.refreshed: This week, in honor of Diwali, we'll be learning about rangoli, then making art of our own! Join us every Tuesday as we learn about an artist or art style, then make art of our own. Recommended for ages 5-12. November Events: November 3 - Frank Buffalo Hyde (drawing); November 10 - Rangoli (Diwali craft); November 17 - Theresa Secord (weaving); November 24 - Jaune Quick-to-See Smith (map art). Free. Registration not required.
